rules.question: What does a command-line tool do when hydra_rules.ini is bad?

exempt.why: The app answers a different question on purpose: it keeps running with analysis off (AppState::rules_error) instead of exiting.

must_not_match: if (const int code = hydra::app::load_tool_rules(rulespath, settings.rules)) return code;
rules.note: Four tools (hydra_batch, hydra_fillcompare, hydra_bench, hydra_replay) each caught the loader's error and printed it on their own. They call load_tool_rules now, so a fifth tool that catches it itself is flagged. Found by: concept audit M25.
